title: Nativity Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle
author: Break Jhon
description:
DESCRIPTION
Celebrate the true meaning of Christmas with this beautiful Nativity Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle featuring three elegant religious holiday designs.
The collection includes a graceful angel, a circular Nativity scene depicting Mary, Joseph, and Baby Jesus, and a beautiful silhouette-style Nativity ornament. With warm wood tones and soft blue accents, these designs are perfect for creating meaningful Christmas decorations and faith-based holiday gifts.
Design Features
• Christmas angel ornament
• Nativity scene ornament
• Mary, Joseph & Baby Jesus design
• Star of Bethlehem details
• Religious Christmas theme
• Elegant layered wooden appearance
• Circular and decorative ornament shapes
• Hanging holes included
• Clean silhouettes suitable for cutting and engraving
• Traditional Christian Christmas imagery
Perfect For
• Christmas tree ornaments
• Nativity Christmas décor
• Christian holiday decorations
• Church Christmas décor
• Religious Christmas gifts
• Advent decorations
• Christmas keepsakes
• Personalized ornaments
• Handmade holiday gifts
• Christmas craft fairs
• Layered wood projects
• Faith-based home décor
• Baby Jesus decorations
• Nativity scene displays
Great For Crafting With
• Glowforge
• xTool
• OMTech
• Cricut
• Silhouette
• LightBurn
• Laser cutters and engravers
Recommended Materials
• 3mm / 1/8 inch plywood
• Basswood
• MDF
• Acrylic
• Cardstock
Use different wood stains, paints, or materials to create beautiful layered Nativity ornaments for your Christmas tree or holiday display.
Digital download only — no physical product will be shipped.
INCLUDED FILE FORMATS
SVG,
DXF,
EPS,
AI,
PDF,
DWG
